description: This file defines a singleton object ApiClient responsible for creating and configuring Retrofit API clients and OkHttp clients, including setting up logging, authentication interceptors, and timeouts. It also provides factory methods to obtain Retrofit service instances for API calls.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A singleton object that provides factory methods for creating configured Retrofit and OkHttp client instances for API communication.

methods.name: createOkHttpClient
methods.description: Creates and configures an OkHttpClient with logging, authentication, and timeouts. Accepts an optional token provider.

methods.name: createRetrofit
methods.description: Creates and configures a Retrofit instance with a base URL, OkHttp client, and Gson converter. Defaults to the base URL from BuildConfig.

methods.name: createStreamlyApiService
methods.description: Creates and returns an implementation of the StreamlyApiService interface using a Retrofit instance.
